en.name: The Santo Cáliz of Valencia
en.summary: An agate cup venerated at Valencia Cathedral is held by tradition to be the chalice of the Last Supper.
en.body: The Santo Cáliz, an agate cup preserved at Valencia Cathedral since the fifteenth century, is venerated by tradition as the very chalice used by Christ at the Last Supper, said to have been carried from Rome to Spain in the early centuries of the Church.
